name: clearcv
description: Free, open-source CV builder. Start from scratch, keep job-specific versions and download PDF or Word files. Your CVs stay on your device.

paragraphs: A calm, local-first CV workspace. Write your story, choose an original layout, build application-specific CVs and letters, track your search and export editable documents — without an account or subscription. Optional AI writing uses an explicitly configured model service.

ClearCV is an independently written open-source implementation of publicly observable CV-building behaviours. It is not affiliated with Enhancv and does not contain its code, branding, templates or private data. The functional expansion covers local free and premium workflow families. The source-linked parity ledger records remaining and unknown capabilities; complete commercial parity is not claimed.
